source_text: Contemporary guidelines, such as those from the American Academy of Pediatrics in 2012, cite modest reductions in UTI risk (90% relative, but 0.1-0.2% absolute) alongside penile cancer prevention, yet these have not reversed declining U.S. rates (from 80% in 1970s births to 58% by 2010), reflecting weaker causal imperatives compared to infectious disease contexts.
